question:
**Computer Graphics & Game Development**

Camera at $R(1,4,2)$ reflects across plane $2x-3y+z=12$.

(1) Find image of camera.

(2) Equation of line joining camera and image.

(3) Find angle this line makes with the plane.

(4) Explain relevance in rendering reflections.
explanation:
Normal $(2,-3,1)$.

Foot of perpendicular $F(27/7,-2/7,24/7)$.

Image $P'(47/7,-32/7,34/7)$.

Line: $(1,4,2)+\lambda(40/7,-60/7,20/7)$.

Angle between line and normal gives $\cos\theta=1$ so line is perpendicular to plane.

Reflection uses normal direction ensuring accurate mirror rendering.

options.A:
(1) Image of camera is $\left(\frac{47}{7},-\frac{32}{7},\frac{34}{7}\right)$
(2) Line joining camera and image is $\vec r=(1,4,2)+\lambda\left(\frac{40}{7},-\frac{60}{7},\frac{20}{7}\right)$
(3) The line is perpendicular to the plane, so it makes $90^\circ$ with the plane
(4) Reflection uses the normal direction to ensure accurate mirror rendering
options.B:
(1) Image of camera is $\left(\frac{27}{7},-\frac{2}{7},\frac{24}{7}\right)$
(2) Line joining camera and image is $\vec r=(1,4,2)+\lambda(2,-3,1)$
(3) The line lies in the plane, so angle is $0^\circ$
(4) This gives only the foot of perpendicular
options.C:
(1) Image of camera is $\left(-\frac{47}{7},\frac{32}{7},-\frac{34}{7}\right)$
(2) Line joining camera and image is $\vec r=(1,4,2)+\lambda(-2,3,-1)$
(3) The angle with plane is $45^\circ$
(4) Reflection is independent of the plane normal
options.D:
(1) Image of camera is $(1,4,2)$
(2) Line joining camera and image is undefined
(3) The camera already lies on the plane
(4) No reflection is required
